messages_without_image_payload.content:
You propose localized annotations for construction drawings. Preserve uncertainty. Return only one JSON object matching this schema:
{"$defs": {"Door": {"additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"id": {"minLength": 1, "title": "Id", "type": "string"}, "bbox_1000": {"maxItems": 4, "minItems": 4, "prefixItems": [{"maximum": 1000, "minimum": 0, "type": "number"}, {"maximum": 1000, "minimum": 0, "type": "number"}, {"maximum": 1000, "minimum": 0, "type": "number"}, {"maximum": 1000, "minimum": 0, "type": "number"}], "title": "Bbox 1000", "type": "array"}, "kind": {"enum": ["single_swing", "double_swing", "sliding", "folding", "unknown"], "title": "Kind", "type": "string"}, "uncertain": {"title": "Uncertain", "type": "boolean"}, "visual_cue": {"title": "Visual Cue", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["id", "bbox_1000", "kind", "uncertain", "visual_cue"], "title": "Door", "type": "object"}}, "additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"doors": {"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/Door"}, "maxItems": 100, "title": "Doors", "type": "array"}, "limitations": {"items": {"type": "string"}, "title": "Limitations", "type": "array"}}, "required": ["doors", "limitations"], "title": "DoorLabels", "type": "object"}

Locate every doorway fitted with a door in the attached floor plan.

Counting rule:
- One physical doorway is one door instance, including a double-leaf door.
- Include interior and exterior doors, and sliding/folding doors if depicted.
- Exclude open passages without a door leaf, windows, furniture, cabinet doors,
  plumbing fixtures, and symbols outside the actual floor plan.
- Do not infer an invisible door from a wall gap alone.

The input image is 2730 pixels wide and 2048 pixels high.
Return one bounding box per door instance, tightly enclosing its visible door
leaf/leaves and swing arc when present. Use bbox_1000 = [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax]
with both axes normalized from 0 to 1000 over the ENTIRE attached image. The
origin is the image's top-left corner. Do not use a cropped plan's coordinate
frame. Box edges must satisfy 0 <= xmin < xmax <= 1000 and
0 <= ymin < ymax <= 1000.

Give each door a unique ID such as D1, its door kind, an uncertainty flag, and a
short observable visual cue. List image limitations separately. Use the image
alone. Do not guess an expected total. The application will count the instances.
